approvalsHint: Merges once this many people approve
approvalsInvalid: Approvals must be a whole number of at least 1
autoMergeHint: When on, an acceptance held by the rules can be set to merge once every check passes
checksHint: Every listed check must pass to merge; a check with a path scope is required only when matching files change
defaultReviewerHint: Reviews tasks that don't say who should review them
dismissStaleHint: Code is usually pushed by AI teammates, so new commits need accepting again; on by default
dispatchSeatHint: Also told to this agent when a PR becomes ready to merge or leaves the merge queue
githubEnforced: GitHub is already enforcing these rules
githubUnknown: Couldn't read GitHub's protection status, so these rules follow this platform's settings
mergeMethodHint: Projects connected to GitHub use the repository's setting; it can't be changed here
overrideHint: People who can let a merge through when checks fail; blank means the project owner and leads
strict: Branch must be up to date with main
strictHint: When on, a branch that is behind is updated before merging
title: Branch protection
